about.title: About Us
about.description1: LegnoVivo was founded with a simple mission: to create beautiful, functional furniture for the modern home. Our pieces are crafted with care, using eco-friendly materials and timeless design that embodies simplicity and elegance.
about.description2: We believe that well-designed furniture should enhance your living space while reflecting your personal style. Each LegnoVivo piece is created with attention to detail and a commitment to quality that will last for generations.

careers.title: Careers at LegnoVivo
careers.subtitle: Join our team of professionals and create unique furniture that will delight people for years to come.

whyJoin.title: Why work with us
whyJoin.text1: LegnoVivo is not just a furniture manufacturing company. We create spaces that become part of our clients' lives, a place for meetings, work, and relaxation.
whyJoin.text2: Our team is a community of talented specialists united by a love for wood and design. We value creative approaches, attention to detail, and the pursuit of continuous improvement.
whyJoin.text3: Working with us, you get opportunities for professional growth, participation in interesting projects, and creating products to be proud of.

benefits.title: Benefits of working at LegnoVivo
benefits.subtitle: We care about our employees and create all the conditions for comfortable work and professional development.

benefit1.title: Professional Development
benefit1.text: We support the desire to learn and improve skills. Training, professional development courses, and participation in professional exhibitions are all available to our employees.

benefit2.title: Creative Atmosphere
benefit2.text: At LegnoVivo, we value every idea. Here you can bring your boldest concepts to life and work with the best materials and equipment.

benefit3.title: Employee Care
benefit3.text: We provide comfortable working conditions, competitive salary, bonuses for achievements, and a friendly team atmosphere.

openings.title: Open Positions
openings.subtitle: Explore our current job openings and join the LegnoVivo team. If you don't find a suitable position, send us your resume — we're always happy to meet talented specialists.

position1.title: Furniture Designer
position1.description: We are looking for an experienced furniture designer who will help us create unique interior items that combine aesthetics, functionality, and sustainability.

position2.title: Master Carpenter
position2.description: We need a wood craftsman with high qualifications and experience in creating premium furniture. You will work with various types of wood and participate in creating exclusive furniture pieces.

position3.title: Customer Relations Manager
position3.description: We're looking for a communicative and responsible manager to work with clients. You will consult clients on our products, help them choose furniture, and ensure a high level of service.
